answer_1.quote: Recently, large language models (LLMs) like Chat-GPT have achieved excellent performance in various NLP tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates the framework on six NLP datasets involving reasoning tasks, where outputs are answers to multiple-choice or fill-in-the-blank questions.

answer_2.quote: We adopt accuracy (Acc) as the evaluation metric and report the average accuracy of three rounds of predictions to reduce randomness.

answer_4.quote: For the human evaluation in our experiments, three evaluators are asked to perform annotations.
answer_4.guideline: We randomly select the experience of 100 tasks from memory and then identify insights that are incorrect, unrelated to the tasks, or cannot be followed by LLMs to report the "Acc".
